messages:
maya: quick copy check — the 'Abort rollout' modal reads a bit alarming. can we soften and make impact clear?

maya: current copy: "Abort rollout? This will immediately stop the new model and may break in-flight requests. This action is irreversible."

chris: I felt the same. 'may break in-flight requests' is vague — does it kill them or just divert? users will panic.

ali: suggestion — 2 lines, factual + outcome: 
"Stop rollout now? New traffic will switch back to the previous model. Active requests will finish on their current runtime; some responses may be incomplete. This action cannot be undone."

jordan: accessibility/ux nit: add a visual cue for destructive action and change button order — secondary (Cancel) on left, primary (Stop rollout) on right but red. also consider adding a short explanation link: 'What happens to requests?'

maya: good point. maybe avoid 'may break' wording. 'some responses may be incomplete' is clearer. also want to avoid legalese 'cannot be undone' — but we do need to warn.

chris: alternate shorter variant: 
"Stop rollout and revert new model?
New traffic will go to the previous model. Running requests will complete but could be truncated.
This cannot be undone."

ali: question — do we actually truncate responses? if we don't, we should say 'may be delayed' instead. accuracy matters.

maya: ops confirmed: running requests will be allowed to finish but there is a timeout and some long-running requests could be terminated by infra. so 'could be truncated' is accurate.

design-bot: accessibility suggestion: include focus trap + descriptive aria-live region with the modal copy. label the destructive button with aria-label for screen readers: "Stop rollout (destructive)". Also recommend a confirmation checkbox only for orgs with at least one policy flagged as high-risk.

jordan: microcopy variant for the modal title: 
- "Stop rollout and revert"
- "Abort rollout" (too sharp)
- "Rollback deploy" (might be unclear)

maya: leaning toward title: "Stop rollout and revert". body:
"Are you sure you want to stop the rollout of the new model? New traffic will be routed to the previous model immediately. Running requests may be truncated by infrastructure timeouts. This action cannot be undone."

chris: +1. maybe swap 'truncated' for 'incomplete' — thats more user-friendly.

ali: final tweak suggestion (compact):
"Stop rollout and revert to previous model. New traffic will route to the prior model immediately. Running requests may be incomplete. This action cannot be undone."

maya: love it. i'll push copy update and add the aria label and button order notes to the PR. tagging @eng-runtime to verify truncation wording with a final sign-off. :thumbsup:

chris: thanks — small but important UX win.

jordan: will follow up on color contrast for the red destructive button in the PR comments.

maya: putting the final suggested copy in the PR description:

Title: "Stop rollout and revert"
Body:
"Stop rollout and revert to previous model. New traffic will route to the prior model immediately. Running requests may be incomplete. This action cannot be undone."

maya: done — thanks everyone! :sparkles:
